chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from one who informed him, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever has his shroud with him in his house will not be recorded among the heedless, and he will be rewarded every time he looks at it.

key_terms.بَيْتِهِ: his home, where the shroud is kept as a reminder
key_terms.كَفَنُهُ: his burial shroud prepared for death
key_terms.نَظَرَ: looked, meaning each time he gazes at it and is reminded
key_terms.ٱلْغَافِلِينَ: the heedless, those inattentive to death and the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for keeping one’s shroud prepared at home?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches mindfulness of death by keeping one’s shroud prepared in the home. Doing so protects a person from heedlessness and brings reward whenever it is looked at, because it reminds one of the Hereafter and the nearness of death.
